card.name: Starting letter G inside split words
card.fires_on: The letter g or G (or -G) that starts a split-up word, such as ganciclovir, gastrointestinal, guanine or gMG. It also fires weakly on 'or' after jpg.

modes.label: g in ganciclovir
modes.description: Lowercase g that begins ganciclovir after a space, 'of', 'Because' or a comma.

modes.label: G in section headings
modes.description: Capital G starting Gastrointestinal right after a section number.

modes.label: Hyphen-g in guanine
modes.description: The -G or -g that starts guanine after hypoxanthine.

card.plain: It marks a lone G that begins a longer medical word such as ganciclovir or gastrointestinal.
